package.name: ral_faults
package.description: Fault-injection boundary nodes. Each one sits on a real data path between a simulated device and its consumers, so a fault changes the data a driver would deliver rather than a dashboard field. Phase 2 contains one, scan_fault_relay, which is the sole publisher of /scan and currently a faithful pass-through of /scan_raw; Phase 4.2 adds scan degradation to it.
